item.title: Reconfiguring Commerce, Capabilities and Culture in Age of Technological Acceleration
item.content:encoded:
India at the intersection of global commerce, technological capabilities, and cultural dynamics presents a unique context for strategic information systems research. This special issue seeks to explore how organizations in India are navigating rapid technological acceleration while maintaining distinct commercial practices and cultural values.
